20164.long_desc: Our 16.6 inch LCD Arcade Marquee with Monitor Side Panel allows you to add a second or third LCD monitor to your Arcooda Game Wizard Xtreme, Taito Vewlix or Chewlix arcade machines. Display your arcade headers, player instructions, or video animations with our Arcooda LCD arcade marquee panels. This is a PLUG AND PLAY steel control panel that includes a 16.6inch LCD monitor. Simply dismantle your arcade machine, remove the metal panel above your monitor, then reassembly the Arcooda 16.6 inch LCD Monitor Side Panel using the same screws and mountings. Its that easy. Unleash Breathtaking Color: Experience a rich spectrum of up to 16.7 million colors (Dithered 1.07B) for stunning visuals that come alive. Wide Viewing Angles: Enjoy a clear picture from virtually any angle thanks to impressive 89° (or higher) viewing angles in all directions. Versatility for Any Use: This versatile display is not just for Arcade, its also ideal for home entertainment, AV applications, public information displays, and more! Superior Performance: This advanced TFT LCD panel delivers exceptional performance, ensuring a truly exceptional viewing experience. Unlimited Arcade Marquee Options: Run your artwork via HDMI and VGA inputs, or, load graphics / promotions and videos on a USB and setup the monitor's media player for the widest visual promotions. Standalone Advertising Display: load your graphics onto a USB drive and insert the drive into the display monitor. If you only have one image, it will display this image on boot up, if you have multiple images, the monitor will cycle through the images. The 16.6inch display monitor also supports videos. Our LCD arcade marquees are designed for the arcade operator with plug and play function allowing you to display arcade graphics, headers, player instructions, game scores, advertising material, and 1080P animated videos. All can be controlled via the extension wiring and secondary button board which can be mounted in the metal frame at front of the machine (on all Game Wizard 3.0 machines). The 16.6inch LCD marquee is made with a full metal case, and has cable management mountings for easy handling of your mounted wires. New Firmware V10 Upgrade - updated screen options including aspect ratio and new language support - screen flip option - VGA, HDMI and USB support - USB supports multiple files and videos - supported video formats for the usb media player include :- MOV H264 (AVC) , MOV MPEG, MP$ H.264 (AVC) and
